title: A family of groups extending McLain's
summary: Given a strict partial order $Δ$ on a set $Λ$ and an arbitrary ring $R$ with $1\neq 0$, the corresponding McLain group $M(Δ)$ has been studied in depth. We construct a larger family of McLain groups $G(Δ)$, where $Δ$ is neither asymmetric nor transitive, while satisfying two weaker axioms.
